comments.author: abtinf
comments.story: ‘Knitting Is Coding’ and Yarn Is Programmable in This Physics Lab
comments.why: Nelson remarks on knitting as a popular programming language
comments.text: Ted Nelson pointed out that knitting (or was it weaving?) is one of the most popular programming languages back in 1979. [VIDEO] Edit to add: I wouldn’t be surprised if there are more knitting programmers today than all computer programming languages combined. Just the size and pervasive presence of Walmart or Joann’s yarn and fabric sections makes me almost certain.
